name: archive
title_zh: 冷表搬出 perm 存成 Parquet 或 Ice
tagline_zh: 热数据占着 perm 又不敢删，是每个 Teradata 库的隐痛。它先按温度给表分档。
tagline_en: Hot data squats on perm but nobody dares drop it. It classifies tables by temperature, slices the exact.
desc_en: Use when moving cold or aged Teradata table data out of perm (block) storage into object storage — as Parquet via Native Object Store (WRITE_NOS + foreign table) or as an Apache Iceberg table in a DATALAKE (Open Table Format) — and when inventorying, federating, restoring or cleaning up such archives. Covers temperature classification, exact-percentage slices and verify-before-delete.
why_zh: 归档的难点不在写，在敢删。它把 WRITE_NOS 与 Iceberg 两条出口都铺好。
why_en: Archiving is easy to write, hard to delete. It wires both WRITE_NOS and Iceberg exits, and makes verification a precondition of.
limit_zh: 只对 Teradata Vantage 有效，别的库用不上；对象存储侧要预先配好 NOS 授权和外部表定义。
limit_en: Teradata Vantage only. Needs pre-configured NOS auth and foreign tables, or writes fail midway. Iceberg path requires DATALAKE licensing; otherwise.
title_en: Archive cold Teradata tables to Parquet or Iceberg
